payload.title: Dedicated tier: the same artefact with one fixed tenant, hooks as tracked gaps, managed upgrades
payload.description: Why: dedicated customers and our own flagship sites run the shared artefact with a fixed tenant in their own AWS account. Hooks exist only here, and each one in use is a gap to promote into core. Papyrus manages upgrades for dedicated customers (stepwise, one index per deploy); people who clone and run it themselves are on their own. Our own sites stay dedicated for now; moving them onto the standard system is hoped for soon and is a later story. Ends with a p.apyr.us page.
